```{r gtts_token_table_add_acoustics}
    mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

safe_voiced_prop <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    mean(!is.na(x))
  }
}

summarise_praat_acoustics <- function(token_id, t1, t2,
                                      pitch_path, formant_path, intensity_path) {
  mid <- (t1 + t2) / 2

  pitch_obj <- rPraat::pitch.read(pitch_path)
  pitch_arr <- rPraat::pitch.toArray(pitch_obj)
  pitch_df <- tibble::tibble(
    time = pitch_arr$t,
    f0_hz = pitch_arr$frequencyArray[1, ]
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(f0_hz = dplyr::if_else(f0_hz <= 0, NA_real_, f0_hz))

  f0_vals <- pitch_df |>
    dplyr::filter(time >= t1, time <= t2) |>
    dplyr::pull(f0_hz)

  intensity_obj <- rPraat::it.read(intensity_path)
  intensity_df <- tibble::tibble(
    time = intensity_obj$t,
    intensity_dB = intensity_obj$i
  )

  intensity_vals <- intensity_df |>
    dplyr::filter(time >= t1, time <= t2) |>
    dplyr::pull(intensity_dB)

  formant_obj <- rPraat::formant.read(formant_path)
  formant_arr <- rPraat::formant.toArray(formant_obj)
  formant_index <- rPraat::formant.getPointIndexNearestTime(formant_obj, time = mid)

  tibble::tibble(
    token_id = token_id,
    f0_median = safe_median(f0_vals),
    f0_voiced_prop = safe_voiced_prop(f0_vals),
    intensity_mean = safe_mean(intensity_vals),
    F1_mid = formant_arr$frequencyArray[1, formant_index],
    F2_mid = formant_arr$frequencyArray[2, formant_index],
    acoustic_source = "Praat saved objects"
  )
}

gtts_token_paths <- gtts_token_table |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pitch_path = sub("\\.wav$", ".Pitch", wav_path),
    formant_path = sub("\\.wav$", ".Formant", wav_path),
    intensity_path = sub("\\.wav$", ".IntensityTier", wav_path)
  )

gtts_can_read_acoustics <- gtts_manifest_enabled &&
  all(file.exists(gtts_token_paths$pitch_path)) &&
  all(file.exists(gtts_token_paths$formant_path)) &&
  all(file.exists(gtts_token_paths$intensity_path))

gtts_acoustic_values <- if (gtts_can_read_acoustics) {
  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    gtts_token_paths |>
      dplyr::select(token_id, t1, t2, pitch_path, formant_path, intensity_path),
    summarise_praat_acoustics
  )
} else {
  set.seed(1720)

  gtts_token_paths |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      token_id,
      f0_median = 178 + 4 * dplyr::row_number() + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 1.5),
      f0_voiced_prop = pmin(1, pmax(0, 0.92 + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 0.025))),
      intensity_mean = 66 + 0.8 * dplyr::row_number() + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 0.4),
      F1_mid = 520 + 25 * dplyr::row_number() + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 8),
      F2_mid = 1900 - 45 * dplyr::row_number() + rnorm(dplyr::n(), 0, 18),
      acoustic_source = "demo values"
    )
}

gtts_token_table_acoustic <- gtts_token_paths |>
  dplyr::left_join(gtts_acoustic_values, by = "token_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    f0_st_100 = dplyr::case_when(
      is.finite(f0_median) & f0_median > 0 ~ 12 * log2(f0_median / 100),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

gtts_token_table_acoustic |>
  dplyr::select(
    recording_id, token_id, label, duration_ms,
    f0_median, f0_voiced_prop, intensity_mean,
    F1_mid, F2_mid, f0_st_100, acoustic_source
  ) |>
  render_inspection_table(
    caption = "gTTS token_table に token-level 音響値を足した例",
    page_length = 8,
    static_rows = 8,
    digits = 2
  )
```

`acoustic_source` が `"demo values"` の行は、列の意味と結合手順を確認するための値です。`.Pitch`、`.Formant`、`.IntensityTier` を実際に保存して読み込んだ場合でも、gTTS 音声の F0 やフォルマントを学習者音声・母語話者音声・実録音条件の代替として解釈してはいけません。ここで確認したいのは、**Praat で保存した音響オブジェクトを、TextGrid 注釈から作った `token_id` に沿って結合できるか**です。

### gTTS trajectory_table と点検図

token-level の表は LMM / GLMM へ渡しやすい一方で、F0 やフォルマントの輪郭を見たい場合は、区間内の複数時点を残した `trajectory_table` が必要です。次のチャンクでは、`gtts_token_table_acoustic` から `time_norm` を持つ trajectory table を作ります。`.Pitch`、`.Formant`、`.IntensityTier` が存在する場合は Praat オブジェクトから時系列値を取り、存在しない場合は同じ列構造のデモ曲線を作ります。

```{r gtts_trajectory_table}
#| eval: true
#| cache: false

interpolate_numeric <- function(time, value, xout) {
  valid <- is.finite(time) & is.finite(value)

  if (sum(valid) < 2) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(xout)))
  }

  stats::approx(
    x = time[valid],
    y = value[valid],
    xout = xout,
    rule = 2,
    ties = "ordered"
  )$y
}

interpolate_f0 <- function(time, value, xout, max_gap_s = 0.03) {
  valid <- is.finite(time) & is.finite(value)

  if (sum(valid) < 2) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(xout)))
  }

  time_valid <- time[valid]
  value_valid <- value[valid]

  interp <- stats::approx(
    x = time_valid,
    y = value_valid,
    xout = xout,
    rule = 1,
    ties = "ordered"
  )$y

  nearest_distance <- vapply(
    xout,
    \(current_time) min(abs(time_valid - current_time)),
    numeric(1)
  )

  dplyr::if_else(nearest_distance <= max_gap_s, interp, NA_real_)
}

make_praat_trajectory <- function(recording_id, speaker_id, item_id, condition,
                                  tier, token_id, label, t1, t2, duration_ms,
                                  pitch_path, formant_path, intensity_path,
                                  n_points = 25) {
  time_sec <- seq(t1, t2, length.out = n_points)
  time_norm <- (time_sec - t1) / (t2 - t1)

  pitch_obj <- rPraat::pitch.read(pitch_path)
  pitch_arr <- rPraat::pitch.toArray(pitch_obj)
  pitch_df <- tibble::tibble(
    time = pitch_arr$t,
    f0_hz = pitch_arr$frequencyArray[1, ]
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(f0_hz = dplyr::if_else(f0_hz <= 0, NA_real_, f0_hz))

  intensity_obj <- rPraat::it.read(intensity_path)
  intensity_df <- tibble::tibble(
    time = intensity_obj$t,
    intensity_dB = intensity_obj$i
  )

  formant_obj <- rPraat::formant.read(formant_path)
  formant_arr <- rPraat::formant.toArray(formant_obj)

  formant_values <- purrr::map_dfr(time_sec, function(current_time) {
    idx <- rPraat::formant.getPointIndexNearestTime(formant_obj, time = current_time)
    tibble::tibble(
      F1 = formant_arr$frequencyArray[1, idx],
      F2 = formant_arr$frequencyArray[2, idx]
    )
  })

  tibble::tibble(
    recording_id = recording_id,
    speaker_id = speaker_id,
    item_id = item_id,
    condition = condition,
    tier = tier,
    token_id = token_id,
    label = label,
    time_sec = time_sec,
    time_norm = time_norm,
    f0_hz = interpolate_f0(pitch_df$time, pitch_df$f0_hz, time_sec),
    intensity_dB = interpolate_numeric(
      intensity_df$time,
      intensity_df$intensity_dB,
      time_sec
    ),
    F1 = formant_values$F1,
    F2 = formant_values$F2,
    trajectory_source = "Praat saved objects"
  )
}

make_demo_trajectory <- function(recording_id, speaker_id, item_id, condition,
                                 tier, token_id, label, t1, t2, duration_ms,
                                 f0_median, intensity_mean, F1_mid, F2_mid,
                                 token_order, n_points = 25) {
  time_sec <- seq(t1, t2, length.out = n_points)
  time_norm <- (time_sec - t1) / (t2 - t1)
  token_shift <- token_order - mean(seq_len(nrow(gtts_token_table_acoustic)))

  tibble::tibble(
    recording_id = recording_id,
    speaker_id = speaker_id,
    item_id = item_id,
    condition = condition,
    tier = tier,
    token_id = token_id,
    label = label,
    time_sec = time_sec,
    time_norm = time_norm,
    f0_hz = f0_median + 3.5 * sin(pi * time_norm) + token_shift,
    intensity_dB = intensity_mean + 1.8 * sin(pi * time_norm),
    F1 = F1_mid + 28 * (time_norm - 0.5) + 12 * sin(pi * time_norm),
    F2 = F2_mid - 55 * (time_norm - 0.5) + 20 * cos(pi * time_norm),
    trajectory_source = "demo values"
  )
}

gtts_trajectory_table <- if (gtts_can_read_acoustics) {
  purrr::pmap_dfr(
    gtts_token_paths |>
      dplyr::select(
        recording_id, speaker_id, item_id, condition,
        tier, token_id, label, t1, t2, duration_ms,
        pitch_path, formant_path, intensity_path
      ),
    make_praat_trajectory
  )
} else {
  gtts_token_table_acoustic |>
    dplyr::mutate(token_order = dplyr::row_number()) |>
    dplyr::select(
      recording_id, speaker_id, item_id, condition,
      tier, token_id, label, t1, t2, duration_ms,
      f0_median, intensity_mean, F1_mid, F2_mid, token_order
    ) |>
    purrr::pmap_dfr(make_demo_trajectory)
}

gtts_trajectory_table |>
  dplyr::group_by(token_id) |>
  dplyr::slice(c(1, ceiling(dplyr::n() / 2), dplyr::n())) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(
    recording_id, token_id, label, time_norm,
    f0_hz, intensity_dB, F1, F2, trajectory_source
  ) |>
  render_inspection_table(
    caption = "gTTS trajectory_table の確認用抜粋",
    page_length = 12,
    static_rows = 12,
    digits = 2
  )
```

```{r gtts_trajectory_plot}
#| eval: true
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-width: 8

gtts_trajectory_table |>
  dplyr::select(token_id, label, time_norm, f0_hz, F1, F2) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(f0_hz, F1, F2),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_norm, y = value, group = token_id, color = label)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.72, linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "gTTS trajectory table check",
    subtitle = "Rows are repeated time points within annotated segments",
    x = "Normalized time within segment",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_speech(12)
```

この図は、GAMM に入る前の形状確認です。`time_norm` は1つの `segment` 内の相対時間であり、縦断研究の `session` や `Time` ではありません。また、`trajectory_table` の行数は独立サンプル数ではありません。同じ `token_id` から複数時点が出ているため、実データでモデル化するときは[トラジェクトリ比較（GAMM）の最小例](#sec-textgrid-template)のように `s(token_id, bs = "re")`、必要に応じて自己相関構造や factor-smooth を検討します。F0 は無声区間を無理に補間せず、近くに有声フレームがない時点は `NA` のまま残します。

### gTTS 表の最小 data contract

Appendix の練習用データでも、表を作ったら最低限の data contract を確認します。ここでの目的は、合成音声の音響値を評価することではなく、**後続モデルへ渡す表として列・ID・範囲・欠測が破綻していないか**を確認することです。

```{r gtts_table_contract}
#| eval: true

gtts_required_token_cols <- c(
  "recording_id", "speaker_id", "item_id", "condition", "session", "tier",
  "interval_index", "token_id", "label", "t1", "t2",
  "duration_ms", "f0_median", "f0_voiced_prop",
  "intensity_mean", "F1_mid", "F2_mid"
)

gtts_required_trajectory_cols <- c(
  "recording_id", "speaker_id", "item_id", "condition", "tier",
  "token_id", "label", "time_sec", "time_norm",
  "f0_hz", "intensity_dB", "F1", "F2"
)

gtts_rows_per_token <- gtts_trajectory_table |>
  dplyr::count(token_id, name = "n_time_rows")

gtts_token_contract <- tibble::tibble(
  table = "gtts_token_table_acoustic",
  check = c(
    "required columns are present",
    "token_id is unique",
    "duration_ms is positive",
    "f0_median is missing or in a broad plausible range",
    "f0_voiced_prop is between 0 and 1",
    "F1_mid / F2_mid are in broad plausible ranges"
  ),
  pass = c(
    all(gtts_required_token_cols %in% names(gtts_token_table_acoustic)),
    anyDuplicated(gtts_token_table_acoustic$token_id) == 0,
    all(gtts_token_table_acoustic$duration_ms > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    all(is.na(gtts_token_table_acoustic$f0_median) |
      dplyr::between(gtts_token_table_acoustic$f0_median, 50, 500)),
    all(is.na(gtts_token_table_acoustic$f0_voiced_prop) |
      dplyr::between(gtts_token_table_acoustic$f0_voiced_prop, 0, 1)),
    all(is.na(gtts_token_table_acoustic$F1_mid) |
      dplyr::between(gtts_token_table_acoustic$F1_mid, 150, 1200)) &&
      all(is.na(gtts_token_table_acoustic$F2_mid) |
        dplyr::between(gtts_token_table_acoustic$F2_mid, 500, 3500))
  )
)

gtts_trajectory_contract <- tibble::tibble(
  table = "gtts_trajectory_table",
  check = c(
    "required columns are present",
    "time_norm is between 0 and 1",
    "each token has at least 5 time points",
    "token_id values exist in token table",
    "f0_hz is missing or in a broad plausible range",
    "F1 / F2 are in broad plausible ranges"
  ),
  pass = c(
    all(gtts_required_trajectory_cols %in% names(gtts_trajectory_table)),
    all(dplyr::between(gtts_trajectory_table$time_norm, 0, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
    all(gtts_rows_per_token$n_time_rows >= 5),
    all(unique(gtts_trajectory_table$token_id) %in% gtts_token_table_acoustic$token_id),
    all(is.na(gtts_trajectory_table$f0_hz) |
      dplyr::between(gtts_trajectory_table$f0_hz, 50, 500)),
    all(is.na(gtts_trajectory_table$F1) |
      dplyr::between(gtts_trajectory_table$F1, 150, 1200)) &&
      all(is.na(gtts_trajectory_table$F2) |
        dplyr::between(gtts_trajectory_table$F2, 500, 3500))
  )
)

dplyr::bind_rows(gtts_token_contract, gtts_trajectory_contract) |>
  dplyr::mutate(result = dplyr::if_else(pass, "pass", "inspect")) |>
  dplyr::select(table, check, result) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "gTTS Appendix tables: minimum data contract")
```

この範囲チェックは、除外基準ではありません。`inspect` になった値は、研究対象・話者・注釈区間に照らして確認する候補です。gTTS のデモ値ではなく実ファイルから作った場合でも、F0 の halving / doubling、フォルマント追跡失敗、短すぎる区間などを Praat 画面と照合してから、欠測化・再推定・除外を判断します。

```{r gtts_missingness_summary}
#| eval: true

gtts_token_missing <- gtts_token_table_acoustic |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c(
        "duration_ms", "f0_median", "f0_voiced_prop",
        "intensity_mean", "F1_mid", "F2_mid"
      )),
      \(x) mean(is.na(x))
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing_rate"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(table = "gtts_token_table_acoustic")

gtts_trajectory_missing <- gtts_trajectory_table |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(c("f0_hz", "intensity_dB", "F1", "F2")),
      \(x) mean(is.na(x))
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "missing_rate"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(table = "gtts_trajectory_table")

dplyr::bind_rows(gtts_token_missing, gtts_trajectory_missing) |>
  dplyr::select(table, variable, missing_rate) |>
  dplyr::mutate(missing_rate = round(missing_rate, 3)) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "gTTS Appendix tables: missingness summary")
```

### gTTS 表を保存する場合

公開レンダーではファイルを書き出しません。手元で Appendix の表を保存したい場合だけ、`SAVE_GTTS_TABLES=true` を設定します。実プロジェクトでは、`analysis/derived/gtts_demo/` のように主分析データと分けた場所へ保存し、合成音声由来であることがファイル名やディレクトリ名から分かるようにします。

```{r gtts_save_tables}
#| eval: true
#| cache: false

save_gtts_tables <- identical(tolower(Sys.getenv("SAVE_GTTS_TABLES", "false")), "true")

if (save_gtts_tables) {
  gtts_out_dir <- file.path("analysis", "derived", "gtts_demo")
  dir.create(gtts_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  readr::write_csv(
    gtts_token_table_acoustic,
    file.path(gtts_out_dir, "gtts_token_table_acoustic.csv")
  )
  readr::write_csv(
    gtts_trajectory_table,
    file.path(gtts_out_dir, "gtts_trajectory_table.csv")
  )

  gtts_saved_files <- tibble::tibble(
    object = c("gtts_token_table_acoustic", "gtts_trajectory_table"),
    path = file.path(
      gtts_out_dir,
      c("gtts_token_table_acoustic.csv", "gtts_trajectory_table.csv")
    ),
    n_rows = c(nrow(gtts_token_table_acoustic), nrow(gtts_trajectory_table))
  )
} else {
  gtts_saved_files <- tibble::tibble(
    object = c("gtts_token_table_acoustic", "gtts_trajectory_table"),
    path = file.path(
      "analysis/derived/gtts_demo",
      c("gtts_token_table_acoustic.csv", "gtts_trajectory_table.csv")
    ),
    n_rows = c(nrow(gtts_token_table_acoustic), nrow(gtts_trajectory_table)),
    status = "not saved; set SAVE_GTTS_TABLES=true to write files"
  )
}

gtts_saved_files |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "gTTS Appendix tables: optional save targets")
```

### Praat / rPraat 練習での使い方

この Appendix で作った WAV は、次のような練習に向いています。

- Praat で `TextGrid` を作り、語・母音・ポーズの tier を付けます。
- `Save as short text file...` で TextGrid を保存し、Git 管理しやすい形式にします。
- `rPraat::tg.read()` で TextGrid を読み、`duration_ms` や `token_id` を作ります。
- manifest に `wav_path`、`textgrid_path`、`recording_id`、`session` を加え、本章の `token table` / `trajectory table` に接続します。

一方で、gTTS 音声を使った F0 やフォルマントの値を、学習者音声・母語話者音声・実録音条件の代替として解釈してはいけません。ここで作る音声は、**ファイル管理と注釈ワークフローの練習素材**として位置づけます。発音研究・知覚実験の刺激として使う場合も、少なくとも生成条件、実行日、音声ファイルそのもの、除外・編集の履歴を固定し、合成音声であることを方法節に明記します。
